hook: An engineered thiamine enzyme joins two molecules into rings, a first for its enzyme class.

readout.label: Top enantiomeric excess of ring products

summary: Researchers mined a new thiamine diphosphate-dependent enzyme and engineered a variant (F484S) that performs an intermolecular [3 + 2] annulation, building chiral spirooxindole lactones. It handled 30 substrate pairs with up to 99% ee and scaled to 2 mmol. The reaction covers one product family, and larger scale is untested.
title: Reprogramming ThDP-Dependent Enzyme for Intermolecular [3 + 2] Annulation via a Homoenolate Intermediate
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
